tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ /phyag rdor rnam sras sbags sgrub la/ /khyer bde don tshang ngag 'don 'di/ /sa skya ngag dbang kun blos bris// swasatwi/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam sras gtor chog rgyun du nyams su len tshul ni chu phyed gtsang mar bum rdzas nyer lnga btab/ zlum gtor gsum chus bran/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu pa chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ dri bzang / 'thor g.yab bcas rdor dril 'thor nas rnams bshams nas/ aṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā+oṃ tsa ma ṇaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta'i mthar rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs khar hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing / ljags 'dril ba dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lung thang gi phreng ba la ci nus bgrangs mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis rgya cher spel la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gong bzhin phyag na rdo rje yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi adz+nyā pa ma ti i daṃ ba ling grih+na tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo ghā ya swāhā/ zhes gsum mam lnga la sogs pas dbul/ gong ltar mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan/ /zhe sdang can rnams 'dul ba'i rtags/ /nyon mongs spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rdo rje lan gsum gsol bas ni/ /gnod sbyin drag po 'dul mdzad pa/ /gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na/ /rgyal po btul nas nor sgrub mdzad/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /me ri 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs/ /rnam rgyal khro bo'i skur bstan nas/ /khro bo'i ngar skad drag po yis/ /thams cad kun 'dus phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /mkha' lding rgyal po'i skur sprul nas/ /klu rgyal thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan༞ /drur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu/ /nag po chen por sku sprul nas/ /rū tra 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa rdzogs pa'am gang rigs kyi mthar/

mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis 'khyil pa'i sngags dang dri bzang gi chus phyogs kun tu bsang gtor bya la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsam/ de la sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams 'khyil pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra prak+ṣo ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āṃ tsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta rnams la spel la mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing / /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang / /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer gtogs bcas/ /ma chags mi zhum zab cing rgya che'i phyir/ /dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gis rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bral 'dod dang / /don med don log cung zad don phyir ni/ /ha cang 'dod ches skyes dang chog ma shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa 'gal mchis mthol lo bshags/ /lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang phongs pa las/ /myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las/ /kun sgrol kun nas phan dang bde ster ba/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad la rjes yi rang / /sna tshogs yang dag 'jigs dang mgon med dang / /sdig sdug brel phongs brgyas gzir skal ngan rnams/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od/

/nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul/ /khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gyings/ /sgeg 'dul bstan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes bzung phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar 'gro skyob khyed la 'gro bde'i slad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur bas/ /bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang / /shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du phog pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid 'od gsal ba spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsams pa ni sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs ma dgu yod pa/ dbus ma'i pho brang sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mo nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing / mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas phyogs rer brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa bco lnga bco lngas spras pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog gis brgyan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams spel mar gnas par/ phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai3 yig gser gyi mdog can/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bai3 yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas dgos 'dod thams cad stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhal nas rin po che'i char 'bebs shing / skye dgu thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las sgrol bas/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol zhing / sku la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon gnyis la nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ seng ge dkar mo nyal stabs su gnas te de nyid la gdong blta ba'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pas/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o/ /phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs rnams su pad+ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/ shar du rmug 'dzin ser po g.yas rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku be ra nag po ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung / nub byang du lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil pa dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang / g.yon pa'i gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la chibs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can no/ /'khor sa bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams dang /

'khor sa tha ma la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa lha srin sde brgyad dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs mi sdug cing brjid la rngams pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin zhing / g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku mdog mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ man ngag las 'byung ba'i spos sam/ med na 'bras phye dang spos dkar bsres pa bsreg cing / rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas te/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sna la 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros pas/ des byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun du bskyed pa'i rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnyis su med par thim par yang bsam zhing / rgyal po 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya'am rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes dam dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai3 swāhā/ oṃ bai3 shra wa ṇa ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ bai3 ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yun tsam brjod pas rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai3 bzhi bzhi bsam zhing / dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs khar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus dbyer med du byas par bsam/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes pas/

rin po che'i cod paṇa gyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po sogs gong ltar bsam/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bsang gtor 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ bai3 shrā wā ṇa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ prak+ṣo ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag dang bcas pas bsang gtor dang / de bzhin du rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur bas nyer spyod dbul/ spro na/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang / /gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang / /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u dang / /mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bkra shis rdzas brgyad dbul/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che/ /dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang / /cang shes rta dang theg chen glang / /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir/ /rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas/ /'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol/ /mtshan sngags kyi mthar sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha sogs kyis rin chen bdun dbul/ yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rnam pa dang / /rnar snyan rol mo'i rnam pa dang / /yid 'dzin dri dang phun tshogs kyi/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas dang / /'jam mnyen 'khril chags na bza' ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga'i tshogs/ /rab 'byams zhing na gang yod rnams/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mtshan sngags kyi mthar pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pu dza sogs kyis 'dod yon dbul/ bsdus pa la dga' na/ de rnams kyi tshigs bcad dor ste sngags tsam gyis dbul/

spro na/ yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin bya gsung yang tshogs bsags sngon du song ba'i tshe ma grub kyang nyes pa med do/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai3 las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gso dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor gter ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod/ rgyal po'i thugs ka'i pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje ser po'i lte bar bai3 yig gser gyi mdog can snying po dang / gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor ba dang / 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ rang gi lce rdo rje sbu gur bsam la sngags bzla ba'i tshe thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse la mchod pa sna tshogs spros te rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po spros te 'jig rten khams kyi mthu stobs/ dbang phyug dpal 'byor/ gzi brjid longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag gi snying gar bstim par bsam zhing / phyag na rdo rje'i sngags ci rigs shig sngon du bzlas la de nas rgyal po'i sngags bzla'o/ /gzungs ni/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/

tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye he/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha me swa dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ su dha na/ su ra ṇe/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes pa ste/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni bzhi 'bum mo/ /'khor gyi sngags/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ya swāhā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ku bai ra ya swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dz+nyā na ya swāhā/ oṃ gu has+d+yā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi kā ya swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swāhā/ oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin rol mo'i bar rigs 'gre/ khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang / /lha mi'i rgud pa ma lus bsal ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong mdzad gnod sbyin chen po sprul/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rgyal po khyod ni rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs las sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ji bzhin mdzad do zhes/ /phyag na rdo rjes yang dag shes la gtod/ /de phyir bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /mthu stobs thogs pa med pas bstan pa srung / /thugs rje chen pos bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong / /sangs rgyas rnams 'phrul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ khaṃ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du brtsegs pa de la dmigs te oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam/ a kā ros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ ru ru s+phu ru nam mkha' mdzod kyis rgya chen por spel/

thun gsham yin na gtor mgron gong gi de nyid la dbul/ min na phyag rdor la yang sngar bshad pa'i cho gas 'dir dbul la/ maṇ+ḍal 'khyil pas bsags la/ shu n+yā tās sbyang ba nas bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod kyi bar gong bzhin byas la/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ oṃ dzaṃ bha lā ya/ pur+ṇa bha dra ya/ ku be rā ya/ saṃ pra dz+nyā na ya/ gu h+yas+d+ya nā ya/ pañtsi kā ya/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye sa pa ri wā ra man gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ oṃ aṣa ṭa nā ga sha ta sa ha pra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra man gong bzhin/ hūm̐ rin chen pho brang dam pa nas/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai3 las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od bas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras zhes mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod paṇa gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la༞ /gnon sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde bo che la༞ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la༞ /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la༞ /dzaṃ bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la༞ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta༞ /g.yon༞ /bum pa༞
